svg.text: From garment photo to business insight
Where images are stored, which Google Cloud services process them, what is extracted, and where the results go

g.text: File name links it to the customer and order
Uploaded in Ads Lab (Command Center, Cloud Run)
with target PINs, age, gender and RFM tier
AI services read them directly by link
Fires automatically when a new photo lands
Safe retries: each image is processed once
Small uploads are processed straight away
Large uploads run as short background batches

svg.text: both image types go through both AI steps

g.text: Reads the photo and any labels
Turns the photo into a visual fingerprint
Never infers gender, age or income · "unknown" is allowed
Yes: link to wardrobe · No: new unique garment
Either way, that PIN code's count goes up by 1
Brand SKU: top 5 look-alikes in each target PIN
give a visual match score from 0 to 1 (read-only)

svg.text: Ads Lab rank score for each brand SKU (0 to 100)
55% visual match + 15% local popularity + 30% attribute fit

g.text: Live data the app reads and writes
Best products for the target PINs

svg.text: Privacy: brand images are compared read-only and never written to customer wardrobes or PIN counts.
The AI never infers gender, age or income. Brands see PIN-level aggregates only, with competitors masked.
